messages:
Riley: Quick brief  we need 2 hero options for each page (Hosted / Dedicated / Private), plus an inbound form + lead scoring rules for launch. Aim to publish tomorrow morning.
Sam: Ill do Hosted variants. Goal: one performance-led, one developer-led. Keep proof lines concrete (p50/p95 examples).
Noor: Ill handle Dedicated + Private bullets and a small benchmark callout. For Private, highlight KMS + network isolation.
Ethan: Ops will implement form slugs and the lead scoring. Proposal for slugs: deployment_choice, lead_intent, company_size, annual_rev_bracket. Also suggest a score field 'lead_score' computed at intake.
Riley: Score rules: demo -> +40, enterprise intent -> +30, company_size enterprise -> +20, private deployment -> +10. Thresholds: score>=70 -> AE immediate alert; 40-69 -> nurture + SDR; <40 -> devx/growth funnels.
Sam: Hosted heroes: A) "Hosted inference, production fast." proof: "sample p50 ~95ms (short Q&A)" CTA: "Get started (free credits)". B) "API-first LLMs that ship fast." proof: "SDKs + quickstart" CTA alt: "View docs"
Noor: Dedicated bullets (micro): "Reserved GPU pools", "Throughput SLAs", "Enterprise support". Benchmark blurb: "Sample: 140 QPS, p95 230ms on standard cluster (sample results)." Private bullets: "VPC & on-prem", "KMS/HSM", "Audit logs & compliance".
Ethan: Routing + scoring pseudo: ```json
{
  "deployment_choice": "Hosted|Dedicated|Private",
  "lead_intent": "demo|enterprise|technical|webinar",
  "company_size": "startup|mid|enterprise",
  "annual_rev_bracket": "<1M|1-10M|10M+"
}
score = base + intents + size + deployment_bonus
if score >= 70 -> route to: sales-ae-queue + slack:#sales-notifs immediate
elif 40 <= score < 70 -> route to: sdr-nurture-queue
else -> route to: devx-queue or growth-rsvp
```
Riley: Good. For form fields we want exact slugs: deployment_choice, lead_intent, company_size, annual_rev_bracket, email. Also include utm params: utm_source=launch, utm_campaign=webinar_apr.
Sam: Add a tiny one-line sample prompt under Hosted: "Example: 'Summarize ticket #123' -> response in ~100ms p50 (sample)." Keeps latency real.
Noor: On Dedicated page add a short FAQ snippet: "Can we reserve capacity across regions? Yes  contact sales for multi-region options."
Ethan: Ill post webhook payload example and test to staging once copy final. Will also implement lead_score as integer in payload for routing. routing-bot: Webhook staging created (job 12005) :white_check_mark:
Riley: Action items:
- Sam: finalize Hosted heroes + 2 CTAs (due 2pm)
- Noor: finalize Dedicated/Private bullets + benchmark copy (due 2pm)
- Ethan: staging webhook + scoring test (due 4pm)
- Riley: assemble final bundle for /marketing-assets and tag #design (due 5pm)
Ethan: Will enable immediate slack pings for AE routes only. Also will include add_tag:private_ops when deployment_choice==Private and score>=70.
Sam: Uploading doc now, will paste link when done.
Noor: Pushing bullets to /marketing-assets after QA.
Riley: Thanks team  ping here when complete. React with :white_check_mark: when your item is done.
